subject: superb lyrebird
title: This Bird Fakes a Panicking Flock to Keep Her From Leaving

scenes.text: This bird can fake a whole flock of panicking birds.
It's the male superb lyrebird, from Australia, and it can copy almost any sound.
But scientists noticed one trick only in two moments: when a female tries to leave, and during mating.
He mimics the alarm calls of a mixed flock mobbing a predator, with wing flaps included.
Other birds reacted to his fake as strongly as to real recordings.
Researchers think the message is: it's dangerous outside, stay here. A bird lying with sound.

description:
This bird can fake a whole flock of panicking birds.
A Current Biology study found male superb lyrebirds mimic mobbing alarm calls when a female tries to leave.
Would you fall for it?
first_comment: Scientists say the female may not actually be fooled. Would you stay or leave?
